_說明: 依 key 的樣式（* 萬用字元）附加給模型的說明，讓它知道這段文字出現在哪裡、長度限制等。

notes.tab.*: drawer tab label, extremely short (1 word)
notes.top.*: top bar label or button, short
notes.float.*: floating text popping up over the game scene, very short and punchy
notes.scene.*: text drawn on the game scene near objects, short
notes.banner.*: event banner at the top of the screen
notes.event.*.name: event title shown in the banner and journal
notes.event.*.prompt: instruction shown while the event is active, tells the player what to click
notes.event.*.hint: vague hint shown in the journal before the event is discovered
notes.event.*.story: short story paragraph in the event journal
notes.event.*.lumia: Lumia's one-line comment about the event
notes.event.*.summary: one-line summary in the journal list
notes.event.*.need: condition for the event to appear
notes.event.*.reward: list of rewards; placeholders are numbers
notes.event.result.*: reward result shown in a notification after completing an event
notes.event.lines.*: Lumia's exclamation when an event starts
notes.buff.*: short label of a temporary boost shown in a small bar
notes.lines.*: Lumia's spoken line when the player interacts with her
notes.mutter.*: Lumia muttering to herself in a small speech bubble; keep short
notes.wish.lines.*: Lumia's spoken line about her little wish
notes.wish.text.*: Lumia's little wish, phrased as what she wants (first person, cute)
notes.gift.*.name: gift item name
notes.gift.*.desc: effect description of the gift when displayed
notes.gift.*.intro: flavor text in the gift collection
notes.gift.*.line: Lumia's reaction when receiving the gift
notes.upgrade.*.name: upgrade name
notes.upgrade.*.desc: upgrade description: flavor sentence, then the effect
notes.redeem.*.name: item bought with Happiness points
notes.story.*.lines: story scene dialogue lines; '露米婭：' marks Lumia speaking, parentheses are narration
notes.letter.*: a letter Lumia receives (placeholder text for now)
notes.status.*: one-line description of what Lumia is doing now
notes.decor.slotNames: names of the four decoration spots in the lounge, very short
notes.app.title: the game title
notes.settings.language: language setting title; keep the bilingual form, e.g. 言語 / Language
